pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark-brown polygons with highly crenulated and jagged margins, exhibiting sharp pixel-level transitions between the pigmented regions and the surrounding light-colored interstitial spaces. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank, decreasing in area toward the lower neck and ventral boundary.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-cream negative space separating the patches. The network consists of narrow pathways with high continuity, meeting at complex multi-directional junction nodes (primarily Y-junctions) with consistent pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck and dorsal hump, representing the mane. The 1D contour shows a dense series of vertical hair peaks against the background.
